units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:6:4">Y. Snh. XI, end, 30ᶜ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="I00822"><he>טְרִיקְלִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 9:3:3">Y. B. Bath. IX, 16ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>היתה חופתו בק׳ וכ׳</he> if his bridal chamber was in the bedroom (of his father’s house), and he (the father) made the wedding meal for him in the dining room.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 33:1">Ex. R. s. 33</cite> <he>כל מקום … ק׳ אחד וכ׳</he> wherever you go, have a bedroom ready for me that I may dwell with you; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S01100"><he>קִיטוֹנוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:6">Midd. I, 6</cite> four cells <he>כק׳ פתוחות וכ׳</he> like bedrooms communicating with the dining room; <cite ref="Yoma 15b:7">Yoma 15ᵇ</cite> <he>כקטוניות</he> (corr. acc.).
